item.title: Why isn't my object found?
item.description: Hi all - I'm working with ACS data and trying to create a descriptive Table 1. I don't understand why my factored gender variable isn't found. I know it's in my dataset, and I can see it in the survey design object summary in the console at the bottom. I made sure the spelling and capitalization are correct. Any ideas? Thank you for your help!
